1강.meaningEn: feasible / realizable / practically achievable
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 현실적인 (=) / 지금 현재 할 수 있는 (=)
1강.explainEn: Matches '현실적인 방안' (realistic measure) in the employment policy reading passage.
1강.mem: Break it down: '실현' (realization/making it real) + '가능한' (possible) = realistic ('현실적인') and doable right now!

1강.meaningEn: countermeasure / policy measure / solution
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 방법 (=) / 방안 (=) / 해결책 (=)
1강.explainEn: A plan or policy prepared to deal with a difficult problem ('취업률을 높일 수 있는 대책').
1강.mem: Whenever a passage talks about solving a social problem, '대책' (countermeasure) paraphrases to '방안' or '방법' (method/solution)!

1강.meaningEn: to be required / demanded / needed
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 필요하다 (=) / 시급하다 (=)
1강.explainEn: Passive of '요구하다'; used in main-idea choices ('실현 가능한 대책이 요구된다' = '필요하다').
1강.mem: In TOPIK II main-idea choices, '~이/가 요구된다' (is required) ALWAYS equals '필요하다' (is needed) or '시급하다' (is urgent)!

1강.meaningEn: to prepare / arrange / establish
1강.partnerKo: 함정 비교: 대책을 마련하고 있다(이미 준비 중) ≠ 대책이 요구된다(필요하다)
1강.explainEn: Means to prepare or set up; watch out for distractor choices claiming the government is ALREADY preparing measures.
1강.mem: Classic Exam Trap: '대책을 마련하고 있다' means the government is ALREADY preparing measures, which contradicts '대책이 요구된다' (measures are needed)!

1강.meaningEn: to have a headache over a problem / be deeply troubled
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 골치만 아프고
유의 표현: 머리가 복잡하고 힘들다
1강.explainEn: '골치' means brain/head; used when a difficult problem causes worry and mental distress.
1강.mem: '골치' means your head/brain. When a problem is too hard to solve alone, your brain aches ('골치가 아프다' = troubled/worried)!

1강.meaningEn: to be arrogant / haughty / stuck-up
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 콧대만 높아지고
유의어: 잘난 체하다 / 거만하다
1강.explainEn: Literally 'nose bridge is high'; describes someone who becomes proud and looks down on others.
1강.mem: Picture someone walking around with their nose ('콧대') held high in the air because they think they are superior = arrogant/stuck-up!

1강.meaningEn: to be quick-witted / quick to read the room or others' moods
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ③: 눈치만 빨라지고
반의어: 눈치가 없다 / 눈치가 둔하다
1강.explainEn: Quickly sensing the atmosphere or another person's hidden thoughts/intentions.
1강.mem: '눈치' is social tact/reading the room. Having fast ('빠르다') '눈치' means you instantly sense the mood or situation!

2강.meaningEn: repeatedly / over and over (with a NEGATIVE nuance)
2강.partnerKo:
유의어: 자주 / 계속
핵심 차이: '자꾸'는 원하지 않는 부정적인 상황이 반복될 때 사용!
2강.explainEn: Professor 오현진 emphasized that while '자꾸' means '자주' (often), '자꾸' carries a NEGATIVE nuance ('새가 상자 밖으로 자꾸 나오려고 한다').
2강.mem: Professor's #1 Nuance Tip: Both '자주' and '자꾸' mean frequently/repeatedly, but '자꾸' is used when an UNWANTED or NEGATIVE action keeps happening!

2강.meaningEn: to find stability / regain peace of mind
2강.partnerKo:
본문 문맥: 자유로운 공간에서는 안정을 찾고
반의 상황: 불안해하다
2강.explainEn: Calming down and feeling safe without anxiety ('안정 = 위험하지 않고 마음이 편안한 상태').
2강.mem: In a free space ('자유로운 공간'), the bird calms down and finds stability/peace of mind ('안정을 찾다')!

2강.meaningEn: to struggle / strive / make every effort
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 노력하다 (=) / 힘쓰다 (=)
2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to exert mental and physical effort ('도망치려고 애쓰지 않는다' = '노력하지 않는다').
2강.mem: Native verb '애쓰다' (strive/struggle with all your might) = Sino-Korean verb '노력하다' (make an effort)!

2강.meaningEn: to be the same / no different
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 같다 (=) / 똑같다 (=)
2강.explainEn: Used to bridge an analogy ('아이도 이와 마찬가지다' = '아이도 새와 똑같다').
2강.mem: Analogy Bridge Signal! When a passage says '아이도 이와 마찬가지다' (A child is the same as this), map the bird story directly onto the child!

2강.meaningEn: restraint / confinement / restriction of freedom
2강.partnerKo:
비유 대응: 새를 상자 안에 넣다 = 아이에 대한 구속(지나친 간섭)
반의어: 자유
2강.explainEn: Restricting someone's freedom of action or thought ('아이는 이를 구속이라 생각하고').
2강.mem: Putting a bird in a box ('상자 안에 넣다') = restricting a child's freedom ('구속' = restraint/confinement)!

2강.meaningEn: to interfere in / meddle in / get involved in
2강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 친구와의 관계에 관여하려고
유의어: 간섭하다 / 끼어들다
2강.explainEn: Stepping into and meddling in matters (such as a child's friendships) rather than leaving them autonomous.
2강.mem: When parents meddle/interfere ('관여하다 = 간섭하다') in a child's friendships, the child feels caged ('구속')!

2강.meaningEn: to escape from / break free from / get out of
2강.partnerKo: 비유 대응: 상자 밖으로 나오다 = 구속에서 벗어나다
2강.explainEn: To break free from restraint, danger, or a confined boundary ('거기에서 벗어나려고 한다').
2강.mem: Just as the bird tries to get out of the box ('밖으로 나오다'), the child tries to break free ('벗어나다') from restraint!

1강.meaningEn: Seeing one, you know ten (A small clue reveals the whole)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 하나를 보면 열을 안다 (교안 표기: 하나를 보면 열은 안다)
의미: 작은 일부만 보고도 전체나 성격을 짐작할 수 있다
1강.explainEn: Proverb meaning that observing just one small action allows you to judge the entire situation or person.
1강.mem: If you see just 1 ('하나') small habit or action, you already know all 10 ('열') things about that person!

1강.meaningEn: to be divided / split into sides
1강.partnerKo: 능동사: 나누다 (to divide) → 피동사: 나뉘다 (to be divided)
1강.explainEn: Explained by Professor 오현진 when describing opinions or groups splitting into two sides ('이쪽과 저쪽으로 나뉘었다').
1강.mem: '나누다' = to divide (active). '나뉘다' = to be divided/split into two opposing sides (passive)!

1강.meaningEn: short-term policy
1강.partnerKo: 반의어: 장기적인 대책 / 근본적인 해결책
1강.explainEn: A temporary, short-sighted measure ('보여 주기 식의 단기적인 정책') that cannot solve root problems.
1강.mem: '단기' = short-term (temporary fix) vs. '장기' = long-term (fundamental solution)!

1강.meaningEn: to be urgent / pressing
1강.partnerKo: 유의어: 급하다 / 빨리 해결해야 한다 / 요구된다
1강.explainEn: So urgent that it cannot be delayed any longer ('현실적인 방안이 시급하다').
1강.mem: '시' (time) + '급' (urgent) = time-critical and urgently needed right now!

2강.meaningEn: to decide the order / sequence
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 누가 1번, 2번으로 할지 차례를 결정하다
2강.explainEn: Deciding who goes first, second, third, etc. ('어떤 일의 순서를 정할 때').
2강.mem: '순서' means sequence/turn (1st, 2nd, 3rd), and '정하다' means to decide!

2강.meaningEn: commonly / frequently / often
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 자주 (=), 많이 (=)
2강.explainEn: Adverb meaning commonly seen or done all the time ('사람들은 흔히 가위바위보를 이용한다').
2강.mem: Professor's equivalence: '흔히' (commonly) = '자주, 많이' (often, a lot)—neutral/general frequency!

2강.meaningEn: in detail / closely / specifically
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 구체적으로 / 구체적이다 (=), 세밀하게 (=)
2강.explainEn: Professor 오현진 highlighted: '자세하다' = '구체적이다' (detailed/concrete).
2강.mem: Observing '자세히' (closely/in detail) = looking at something '구체적으로' (specifically/concretely)!

2강.meaningEn: namely / in other words / that is to say
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 바로 (=), 다시 말하면 (=)
2강.explainEn: Crucial reading clue! The sentence after '즉' explains the exact answer to the blank right before it.
2강.mem: Golden Reading Rule: Whenever '즉' (namely/in other words) appears right after a blank, the sentence after '즉' is the exact definition of the blank!

2강.meaningEn: to win (이기다) / to lose (지다) / to tie or draw (비기다)
2강.partnerKo:
반의어: 이기다 ↔ 지다
0대 0 동점: 비기다 (무승부)
2강.explainEn: Professor 오현진 taught all three outcomes together during the rock-paper-scissors lecture!
2강.mem: Know all 3 game outcomes: Win = '이기다', Lose = '지다', and Tie/Draw (0:0 or same move in rock-paper-scissors) = '비기다'!

2강.meaningEn: on the other hand / whereas
2강.partnerKo:
유의 표현: 반대로 / -(으)나 / -지만
문맥: 이긴 사람은 유지하는 반면에 진 사람은 바꾼다
2강.explainEn: Contrasts two opposite behaviors or facts between the front clause and back clause.
2강.mem: '반면에' (on the other hand/whereas) is a mirror: whatever is in front of '반면에', put the exact opposite behind it!

2강.meaningEn: a consistent tendency / regular behavioral pattern
2강.partnerKo:
기출 정답 ②: 일정한 경향이 있음을
오답 함정 ①: 다양한 종류가 있음을 (X)
2강.explainEn: When winners always keep their move and losers always switch, that repeatable pattern is '일정한 경향'.
2강.mem: Winners keep ('유지하다') + Losers switch ('바꾸다') = a predictable, consistent behavioral pattern ('일정한 경향'), NOT various kinds ('다양한 종류')!

1강.meaningEn: to feel a sense of burden / psychological pressure
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 무거운 마음을 가지다 (=) / 심리적 압박을 느끼다
1강.explainEn: Mental pressure ('실수에 대한 부담감') that prevents an athlete from performing well.
1강.mem: Professor's definition: '부담감' (sense of burden/pressure) = '무거운 마음' (a heavy heart worried about making a mistake)!

1강.meaningEn: to achieve good results / get a good score or record
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 좋은 점수를 받다 (=) / 좋은 결과를 얻다 (=)
1강.explainEn: '거두다' literally means to harvest crops; figuratively used with '성적/성과/승리' to mean achieving results.
1강.mem: '거두다' means to harvest/reap. In sports or exams, '좋은 성적을 거두다' means to reap good results ('좋은 점수를 받다')!

1강.meaningEn: therefore / because of that / for that reason
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 그래서 (=) / 따라서 (=) / 그러므로 (=)
1강.explainEn: Connects the cause (athlete's pressure) to the required coaching method in the next sentence.
1강.mem: '그렇기 때문에' = '그래서 / 따라서' (Therefore)—the sentence right after it states the author's main point!

1강.meaningEn: to coach / instruct / guide
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 가르치다 (=)
1강.explainEn: For a coach ('감독') or teacher to guide and train athletes or students ('감독은 선수를 지도할 때').
1강.mem: When a sports coach ('감독') instructs and trains players ('선수를 지도하다'), it means '가르치다' (to teach/guide)!

1강.meaningEn: to remind of / cause to recall / bring to mind
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 생각나게 하다 (=) / 기억나게 하다 (=)
1강.explainEn: Causative of '떠오르다' (to come to mind); making someone remember past mistakes ('실수를 떠올리게 하는 말').
1강.mem: '떠오르다' = come to mind. '떠올리게 하다' = make something come to mind ('생각나게 하다' / remind someone of mistakes)!

1강.meaningEn: to utter / speak out loud / mention
1강.partnerKo:
기출 정답 ①: 입 밖에 내지 (않아야 한다)
의미: 말을 꺼내어 밖으로 표현하다
1강.explainEn: Literally 'put outside the mouth' = to say out loud. Combined with '-지 않아야 한다', it means 'must NOT utter/mention'.
1강.mem: Literally 'put words outside your mouth' ('입 밖에 내다' = speak out loud). Always check the negative ending after the blank: '입 밖에 내지 않아야 한다' = must NOT say out loud!

2강.meaningEn: to give trust / credibility to the reader
2강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 독자에게 신뢰를 주는
비교 선택지 ②: 독자에게 새로운 정보를 주는
2강.explainEn: Making readers believe and trust the article through accurate facts or objective evidence.
2강.mem: From Week 1 & Week 3: '신뢰' = trust/credibility ('믿음'). Reporters using verified facts write articles that give trust to readers ('독자에게 신뢰를 주는')!

2강.meaningEn: the more [A], the more [B]
2강.partnerKo: 본문 문장: 긍정적인 결과를 기대할수록 좋은 결과를 얻을 확률이 높다
2강.explainEn: Proportional grammar pattern indicating that as Condition A intensifies, Result B increases or decreases.
2강.mem: '기대할수록' = the more you expect, '확률이 높다' = the higher the probability!

2강.meaningEn: the probability is high ↔ the probability is low (hard to obtain)
2강.partnerKo: 유의 전환: 좋은 결과를 얻을 확률이 낮다 = 좋은 결과를 얻기 어렵다
2강.explainEn: '확률' means mathematical/statistical probability or likelihood.
2강.mem: In Writing Q52, you can invert '좋은 결과를 얻을 확률이 높다' either to '확률이 낮다' OR to '좋은 결과를 얻기 어렵다'!

2강.meaningEn: conversely / on the contrary / in the opposite way
2강.partnerKo: 쓰기 52번 공식: '반대로' 뒤의 빈칸은 앞 문장 단어들을 모두 반의어로 뒤집기!
2강.explainEn: Signals that you must invert both the subject/condition ('긍정적 → 부정적') and predicate ('확률이 높다 → 얻기 어렵다').
2강.mem: Professor's Q52 Golden Rule: When '반대로' precedes a blank, flip every keyword in the previous sentence to its antonym and end with '-다'!

1강.meaningEn: early days / initial period / beginning stage
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 처음 시기 (=) / 초기 (=)
1강.explainEn: '초창기 이모티콘은 감정을 표시하는 정도였으나' (In the early days, emoticons merely displayed emotions).
1강.mem: '초' (first/beginning = 처음) + '기' (period = 시기) → '초창기' = '처음 시기' (the early days of emoticons)!

1강.meaningEn: to express / indicate / display with a sign
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 나타내다 (=) / 표현하다 (=)
1강.explainEn: To show or mark feelings or information outwardly ('감정을 표시하는 정도').
1강.mem: '감정을 표시하다' (display/indicate feelings with symbols) = '감정을 나타내다 / 표현하다'!

1강.meaningEn: to induce / cause / trigger laughter
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 웃음을 일으키다 (=) / 웃게 만들다 (=)
1강.explainEn: '유발하다' means to cause or trigger a phenomenon or emotion ('재미를 주고 웃음을 유발하기도 한다').
1강.mem: Professor's key reading pair: '웃음을 유발하다' (induce/trigger laughter) = '웃음을 일으키다' (cause laughter)!

1강.meaningEn: ceaselessly / continually / without stopping
1강.partnerKo: 유의어: 계속해서 (=) / 멈추지 않고 (=)
1강.explainEn: Derived from '끊이다' (to stop/be cut off) + '-없이' (without) = without ever stopping.
1강.mem: '끊임' (cutting/stopping) + '없이' (without) = without ever stopping ('계속해서' / ceaselessly)!

1강.meaningEn: to evolve / develop into a more advanced form
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 유의어: 발전하다 (=) / 변화하고 발달하다
1강.explainEn: Used figuratively for technology or media ('이모티콘은 끊임없이 진화를 계속하고 있다') advancing from simple symbols to moving characters.
1강.mem: When emoticons evolve ('진화하다') from simple text symbols into animated characters, they develop/advance ('발전하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to look back on / reflect on one's childhood
2강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 어린 시절을 되돌아보려는
오답 함정 ①: 아이들을 교육하려는
2강.explainEn: '되돌아보다' means to look back on the past and reminisce.
2강.mem: '되돌아보다' = turn back and look at the past. Adults buying childhood toys/cartoons want to look back on their childhood ('어린 시절을 되돌아보려는')!

2강.meaningEn: to gather / collect public opinions
2강.partnerKo:
유의어: 의견을 모으다 (=)
반의어: 확산하다 = 퍼지다
2강.explainEn: Standard TOPIK II collocation where an organization collects diverse opinions into a unified policy.
2강.mem: Remember Week 4 Quiz Q4: '수렴하다 = 모이다/모으다' (opinions converge and gather together)!

2강.meaningEn: to adhere / stick firmly to a traditional method
2강.partnerKo:
유의어: 전통 방식을 굳게 지키다 (=)
반의어: 방식을 전환하다 (바꾸다)
2강.explainEn: Refusing to change to a modern method and keeping the original way intact.
2강.mem: Remember Week 4 Quiz Q2: '고수하다 = 지키다' (stubbornly stick to and keep a principle or method)!

1강.meaningEn: to build a wall (completely cut off contact or interest)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지: 담을 쌓고 / 담을 쌓는다
의미: 관계를 완전히 끊거나 관심을 전혀 두지 않다
1강.explainEn: Literally 'build a wall'; used when someone completely severs ties with a person or has zero interest in a subject.
1강.mem: Appears in BOTH Week 5 and Week 7! Building a wall ('담을 쌓다') between yourself and a topic means cutting off all contact or interest!

1강.meaningEn: to drive a nail (1. state with finality / 2. hurt someone's heart deeply)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 못을 박고
의미 1: 바꿀 수 없게 확실히 말하다 / 의미 2: 가슴에 깊은 상처를 주다
1강.explainEn: Used either for declaring something definitively so it cannot be changed, or causing deep emotional pain ('가슴에 못을 박다').
1강.mem: Hammering a nail ('못을 박다') into wood fixes it permanently = stating something with absolute finality (or driving a nail into someone's heart)!

1강.meaningEn: to put heads together (gather and discuss seriously to solve a problem)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ③: 머리를 맞대고
유의 표현: 함께 모여 진지하게 의논하다
1강.explainEn: Literally 'touch foreheads together'; people gathering closely to brainstorm and solve a shared problem.
1강.mem: Picture teammates leaning over a table with their heads touching ('머리를 맞대다') to brainstorm a solution together!

1강.meaningEn: to bow one's head (yield, admit defeat, feel ashamed, or show respect)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ④: 고개를 숙이고
의미: 잘못을 부끄러워하거나 상대에게 굴복하다(또는 존경하다)
1강.explainEn: Lowering one's head out of shame, defeat, or humility.
1강.mem: Lowering/bowing your head ('고개를 숙이다') shows shame after a mistake, admitting defeat, or humble respect!

2강.meaningEn: eraser crumbs / shavings
2강.partnerKo: 본문 문맥: 글씨를 지울 때 나오는 지우개 가루
2강.explainEn: Key term from the Week 5 Lecture 2 reading passage comparing soft vs. hard erasers.
2강.mem: '지우개' (eraser) + '가루' (powder/crumbs) = the little shavings left behind when you erase!

2강.meaningEn: special substance / particular material
2강.partnerKo:
5주차 2강 퀴즈 Q4 연계: 특수하다 = 특별하다 (=)
본문: 특수한 물질을 넣어 단단하게 만든 지우개
2강.explainEn: A special substance added to make the eraser hard ('단단하다 = 딱딱하다') for erasing ink or rough paper.
2강.mem: Direct link to Week 5 Quiz Q4 ('특수하다 = 특별하다')! Hard pen-erasers contain a special substance ('특수한 물질 = 특별한 물질')!

2강.meaningEn: soft eraser (for pencil) ↔ hard/firm eraser (for pen/ink)
2강.partnerKo:
유의어: 단단하다 = 딱딱하다 (1주차 2강 퀴즈 Q4)
반의어: 부드럽다 / 말랑말랑하다
2강.explainEn: Soft erasers erase pencil marks gently, whereas hard erasers containing special substances erase ink by scraping the paper surface.
2강.mem: Pencil ('연필') = soft eraser ('부드러운 지우개'). Ballpoint/fountain pen ('볼펜/만년필') = hard eraser ('단단한 지우개') that scrapes the paper surface!

2강.wordKo: 방의 구조에 맞게 / 장식에 따라 다르게
2강.meaningEn: suiting the structure of the room (①) / differently according to the decoration (②)
2강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 방의 구조에 맞게
기출 선택지 ②: 장식에 따라 다르게
2강.explainEn: Verified slide options from the Week 5 Lecture 2 (제47회) reading blank question.
2강.mem: '구조' = structure/layout ('방의 구조에 맞게' = suiting the room's layout) vs. '장식' = decoration ('장식에 따라 다르게')!

1강.meaningEn: to weigh pros and cons / calculate ahead and behind carefully
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 앞뒤를 재고
의미: 이익과 손해, 전후 사정을 꼼꼼히 따져 보다
1강.explainEn: Literally 'measure front and back'; means carefully calculating gains, losses, and consequences before acting.
1강.mem: '앞뒤' (front and back) + '재다' (measure with a ruler) = measuring every angle and weighing pros and cons before making a move!

1강.meaningEn: to pull out / withdraw from involvement or a group
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 발을 빼지 않고 (물러서지 않고 끝까지 참여함)
유사 관용어: 손을 떼다 (7주차 1강)
1강.explainEn: Literally 'pull one's foot out'; means to step back and escape responsibility or involvement in an affair.
1강.mem: Pulling your foot out ('발을 빼다') = backing out of a situation. On the slide, '② 발을 빼지 않고' has '-지 않고' (WITHOUT backing out)!

1강.meaningEn: to check carefully / look around attentively
1강.partnerKo: 본문 문맥: 학교 앞 천천히! 아이들이 있는지 한 번 더 살피세요 → 정답: ① 안전 운전
1강.explainEn: To look around carefully and check whether children are crossing the street.
1강.mem: From the Safe Driving ('안전 운전') public ad: '학교 앞 천천히! 아이들이 있는지 한 번 더 살피세요' (Slow down in front of schools and check carefully for kids)!

1강.meaningEn: name (honorific: 성함) / number of people (인원수) / contact number (연락처)
1강.partnerKo: 본문 문맥: 식사를 원하는 날짜와 시간, 인원수 선택 + 성함과 연락처 입력 → 정답: ① 예약 방법
1강.explainEn: Essential practical nouns used in restaurant/facility reservation instructions ('예약 방법').
1강.mem: Selecting date, time, party size ('인원수'), and entering your honorific name ('성함') and phone number ('연락처') = Reservation Method ('예약 방법')!

2강.meaningEn: if one manages/maintains it cleanly
2강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 깨끗하게 관리하면
비교 선택지 ②: 감싸서 보호해 주면
2강.explainEn: Option ① from the Week 6 Lecture 2 (제52회) reading blank question.
2강.mem: '깨끗하게' (cleanly) + '관리하면' (if you manage/care for it)—compare with Option ② '감싸서 보호해 주면'!

2강.meaningEn: if one wraps/covers and protects it
2강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 감싸서 보호해 주면
핵심 동사: 감싸다 (to wrap/cover), 보호하다 (to protect)
2강.explainEn: Option ② from the Week 6 Lecture 2 (제52회) reading blank question.
2강.mem: '감싸다' (wrap/cover) + '보호해 주다' (protect) = wrapping and protecting a wound or object so it isn't damaged!

2강.meaningEn: to be doubtful/suspicious = to be suspicious/fishy
2강.partnerKo:
6주차 2강: 의심스럽다 = 수상하다 (O)
1주차 1강: 의심스럽다 = 신뢰하다 (X)
2강.explainEn: The #1 cross-week exam connection in this course!
2강.mem: Never forget this pair: Week 1 '의심스럽다 = 신뢰하다' is FALSE (X), while Week 6 '의심스럽다 = 수상하다' is TRUE (O)!

1강.meaningEn: to take one's hands off (quit / withdraw from a task or business)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ①: 손을 뗀다
의미: 하던 일을 그만두거나 관계를 끊다
1강.explainEn: Literally 'remove one's hands'; means to stop doing an activity or pull out of a project completely.
1강.mem: Taking your hands off ('손을 떼다') the keyboard or project = quitting/stopping the work completely!

1강.meaningEn: to grind one's teeth (harbor fierce anger or determination to win)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ②: 이를 간다
의미: 몹시 분해하거나 꼭 이기려고 굳게 마음먹다
1강.explainEn: Grinding one's teeth out of intense resentment or fierce determination before a match.
1강.mem: Grinding your teeth ('이를 갈다') shows intense anger or fierce determination to beat a rival!

1강.meaningEn: to raise heat/fever (get deeply enthusiastic or absorbed in)
1강.partnerKo:
기출 선택지 ④: 열을 올린다
유의 표현: 어떤 일에 몹시 열중하다 / 적극적으로 힘을 쏟다
1강.explainEn: Becoming passionately absorbed or heated up in promoting, studying, or competing in something.
1강.mem: '열' means heat/passion (like '열의'). Raising the heat ('열을 올리다') means getting super enthusiastic and absorbed in an activity!

1강.meaningEn: to increase (늘어나다) ↔ to decrease (줄어들다)
1강.partnerKo:
증가하다 = 늘어나다 (↑)
감소하다 = 줄어들다 (↓)
1강.explainEn: Essential graph description verbs for TOPIK II Writing Q53.
1강.mem: For Writing Q53 graphs: Arrow UP (↑) = '증가하다 / 늘어나다' (increase). Arrow DOWN (↓) = '감소하다 / 줄어들다' (decrease)!

2강.meaningEn: to introduce / adopt a method or system
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 방식 = 방법 (=) / 도입하다 = 가져오다 (=)
2강.explainEn: '수업에 게임 방식을 도입하면' = '수업에 게임하는 방법을 가져오면'.
2강.mem: Professor's breakdown: '방식' = method ('방법') + '도입하다' = bring in/adopt ('가져오다')!

2강.meaningEn: to have enthusiasm / zeal / eager determination
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 열의 = 열정(뜨거운 마음)과 의지(내가 하겠다는 마음)!
2강.explainEn: Professor 오현진 broke '열의' down syllable by syllable: '열(열정 - passion) + 의(의지 - willpower)'.
2강.mem: Professor's syllable formula: '열' (from '열정' = burning passion) + '의' (from '의지' = 'I will do it!' willpower) = '열의' (enthusiasm)!

2강.meaningEn: to be thrilling / full of interest / super fun
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 아주 재미있다 (=)
2강.explainEn: '흥미진진한 퀴즈를 풀며' = solving super interesting and exciting quizzes.
2강.mem: '흥미' means interest/fun, and '흥미진진하다' means brimming with excitement ('아주 재미있다' = super fun)!

2강.meaningEn: to master / learn terminology and concepts
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 용어 = 단어 / 개념 = 컨셉 / 익히다 = 배우다, 공부하다, 익숙하게 만들다!
2강.explainEn: Professor 오현진 explained '익히다' as studying and making something familiar ('익숙하게 만들다').
2강.mem: '용어' = technical words ('단어'), '개념' = concepts, and '익히다' = learn and make familiar ('배우다 / 익숙하게 만들다')!

2강.meaningEn: immediately / instantaneously / on the spot
2강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 바로 (=), 즉시 (=)
2강.explainEn: '퀴즈의 정답을 맞힌 학생에게는 즉각적으로 보상이 주어지기 때문에' = because rewards are given immediately on the spot.
2강.mem: Professor's equivalence: '즉각적으로' (instantaneously/on the spot) = '바로, 즉시' (immediately/right away)!

2강.meaningEn: to concentrate MORE on the class
2강.partnerKo:
기출 정답 ②: 수업에 보다 집중할 (수 있게 된다)
오답 함정 ③: 게임에 흥미를 느낄 (X)
문법 포인트: 부사 '보다' = '더' (more)
2강.explainEn: In '수업에 보다 집중할', the adverb '보다' means '더' (more), describing the positive educational effect of classroom quiz games.
2강.mem: Watch out for Option ③ ('게임에 흥미를 느낄')! The teacher's true goal in using quiz games is helping students concentrate MORE ('보다 = 더') on the CLASS ('② 수업에 보다 집중할')!

1강.meaningEn: to appear / emerge on the scene (characters in a story)
1강.partnerKo:
교수님 풀이: 등장하다 = 세상에 새로 나오다 (=)
등장인물 = 소설·드라마에 나오는 사람
1강.explainEn: '새로운 문화 콘텐츠들이 등장하고 있다' = new cultural contents are appearing.
1강.mem: '등장하다' = '나오다' (to appear/come out). And '등장인물' = the people/characters who appear ('나오는 사람') in a web novel!

1강.meaningEn: one's eyes get fatigued / tired
1강.partnerKo: 교수님 풀이: 피로하다 = 피곤하다 (=)
1강.explainEn: '컴퓨터 화면에서 읽어도 눈이 피로하지 않도록' = so that readers' eyes do not get tired on screens.
1강.mem: Web novels use short sentences so readers' eyes don't get fatigued ('눈이 피로하지 않도록' = '눈이 피곤하지 않게') on phone/PC screens!

1강.meaningEn: the setting/background and characters are simple
1강.partnerKo: 웹소설 2대 특징: ① 문장을 짧게 쓴다, ② 배경과 등장인물이 단순하다(복잡하지 않다)
1강.explainEn: Web novels keep the setting ('배경') and characters ('등장인물') simple and use short sentences ('문장도 짧게 쓴다').
1강.mem: Remember the 2 traits of Web Novels ('웹소설'): 1) Short sentences so eyes aren't tired, 2) Simple setting & characters ('배경과 등장인물이 단순하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to be sluggish / make very slow progress
2강.partnerKo:
교수님 풀이: 잘 진행되지 않다 (=)
기출 제목: 지지부진한 태풍 피해 복구
2강.explainEn: Headline word describing recovery work ('복구') that is dragging on and barely progressing.
2강.mem: Headline #1: '지지부진한 태풍 피해 복구' (sluggish typhoon damage recovery) = '복구가 잘 진행되지 않아' (recovery is not progressing well)!

2강.meaningEn: to be bursting with frustration / suffocated with impatience
2강.partnerKo:
교수님 풀이: 답답해하다 (=)
기출 제목: 속 터지는 인주 주민들 → 인주 주민들이 답답해하고 있다
2강.explainEn: Because typhoon recovery is sluggish ('지지부진한'), the residents feel extreme frustration ('속 터지는 주민들' = '답답해하고 있다').
2강.mem: When recovery drags on forever, the residents' insides burst with frustration ('속 터지는 주민들') = they feel frustrated ('답답해하고 있다')!

2강.meaningEn: to be an unknown quantity / uncertain whether it will happen
2강.partnerKo:
교수님 풀이: 앞으로 어떻게 될지 '알 수 없다' (=)
기출: 인력 안정적으로 공급하는 것은 미지수 = 안정적으로 줄 수 있을지 알 수 없다
2강.explainEn: From mathematical unknown 'x' ('미지수'); in newspaper headlines it always paraphrases to '알 수 없다'.
2강.mem: Professor's #1 Newspaper Formula: In math, '미지수' is the unknown variable 'x'. In a headline, '미지수이다' ALWAYS maps to '알 수 없다' (cannot be known yet)!

2강.meaningEn: a drop by a large margin / sharp fall
2강.partnerKo:
교수님 풀이: 크게 떨어지다 (=)
반의어: 큰 폭으로 상승 (크게 오르다)
2강.explainEn: '기름값 큰 폭으로 하락' = oil prices fell sharply ('크게 떨어져').
2강.mem: '큰 폭으로' = by a wide margin ('크게') + '하락' = drop/fall ('떨어지다'). Opposite: '큰 폭으로 상승' = rise sharply ('크게 오르다')!

2강.meaningEn: to take on vitality / become lively and booming
2강.partnerKo:
교수님 풀이: 분위기가 좋아지다 (=) / 활발해지다 (=)
기출 제목: 활기 띠는 제조업체 (물건을 만드는 회사)
2강.explainEn: Because oil prices dropped sharply, manufacturing companies ('제조업체') are booming ('활기를 띠다' = '분위기가 좋아지고 있다').
2강.mem: When oil prices drop sharply, manufacturing companies ('제조업체') take on lively energy ('활기를 띠다') = their business atmosphere improves ('분위기가 좋아지고 있다')!
